summary.text: Sonya Wimberly Hawkins is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia State Senate, District 16, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Marty Harbin.
According to Ballotpedia, Wimberly Hawkins has worked as an entrepreneur and holds a bachelor's degree from Saint Leo College.

paragraphs.text: Sonya Wimberly Hawkins graduated from Lindblom Technical High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Saint Leo College and attended Southern University and A&M College.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as an entrepreneur.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a community advocate and 26-year resident of Fayetteville, Georgia, and said she holds a bachelor's degree in sociology with a minor in political science.
She said she is a member of Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Inc., the NAACP and the Fayette County Democrats.
Wimberly Hawkins defeated Pauline Henley, 72.6% to 27.4%, in the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary for District 16.
In the survey, she said her campaign focuses on protecting voting rights, strengthening economic development, improving maternal health outcomes and ensuring access to quality education.
